integrity: General theorem proved by a self-contained probabilistic coupling argument. Programmatic checks are finite corroboration, not an infinite proof. Historical priority is a best-knowledge conclusion; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires coordinate subgroups in an unconditionality basis; does not cover arbitrary skew subgroups or all convex sets in rank at least three. Earlier equivalent order-ideal formulations remain a historical-priority risk.
title: All-rank coordinate residue monotonicity and rigidity for unconditional lattice sets
